The obvious problem with a throwaway account is the ability to spam or troll. Of course, voat is in better shape than reddit in how they've set up the rules to downvoat.

I like the idea of better control of a throwaway. Could it be an account that could only post (1) link or could only comment on one thread with a sunset on the account? Comments received on this account could be forwarded to a main account. (This would bring an interesting element of danger that the person posts as their main account and not throwaway)

Yeah this is a great idea, maybe it should also be associated with the main account, so PM's sent to the throwaway account appear in the main account's inbox, and it would allow easily switching between the them, or maybe choosing which account to post a comment as, when using the main account.

This is good in theory but I think for the type of sensitive situations roznak is talking about there's too much potential for tracing the temporary account back to the original owner. Either through unwanted snooping or if (heaven forbid) Voat were to be compromised and account details leaked. For true anonymity it would be best to keep the accounts completely separate.

Not only the potential for something to be traced back to the main account but the possibility to accidentally post something as your main account instead of the throwaway account. There would have to be some sort of automatic switching involved so that if you started a thread with the throwaway it wouldn't let you post from the main account or something like that to help eliminate the possibility of posting as your main account.
